<h3 class="access-form__title">Entrepreneurial Finance</h3>
<p class="access-form__intro">Enter the course password to access the materials.</p>

:::: {.form-group}
<label class="form-label" for="course-pw">Password</label>
<input class="form-input" type="password" id="course-pw" placeholder="Enter password" autocomplete="off">
::::

<button class="form-submit" id="access-btn">ACCESS MATERIALS</button>

[]{.access-form__error #access-error}

:::

:::
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  const encrypted = {
    salt: "yPpR6gOehDXqTR2jxPPZlw==",
    iv: "jw2WN6XKGlG0F4VC",
    ciphertext: "15OnKPkCEZ/38UQy9iVVr72kqtm3Zt52zEgvcHaopYzbq088iFeb934ebJH1awk6i/D2wAoLBg=="
  };

  function b64ToBytes(b64) {
    return Uint8Array.from(atob(b64), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
  }

  async function decrypt(password) {
    const salt = b64ToBytes(encrypted.salt);
    const iv = b64ToBytes(encrypted.iv);
    const ct = b64ToBytes(encrypted.ciphertext);
    const enc = new TextEncoder();
    const keyMaterial = await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw", enc.encode(password), "PBKDF2", false, ["deriveKey"]);
    const key = await crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
      { name: "PBKDF2", salt: salt, iterations: 100000, hash: "SHA-256" },
      keyMaterial,
      { name: "AES-GCM", length: 256 },
      false,
      ["decrypt"]
    );
    const decrypted = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: "AES-GCM", iv: iv }, key, ct);
    return new TextDecoder().decode(decrypted);
  }

  async function submit() {
    const pw = document.getElementById("course-pw").value;
    const err = document.getElementById("access-error");
    if (!pw) { err.textContent = "Please enter a password."; return; }
    try {
      const url = await decrypt(pw);
      window.location.href = url;
    } catch (e) {
      err.textContent = "Incorrect password. Please try again.";
    }
  }

  document.getElementById("access-btn").addEventListener("click", submit);
  document.getElementById("course-pw").addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
    if (e.key === "Enter") submit();
  });
})();
</script>
```
